messages:
sara (growth): quick thread  goal: build a tiny CFO-forward bench narrative for the launch. single hero line for finance, one compact "runway" chart, plus dev-facing appendix. owners?
josh (marketing): happy to own the finance copy + AB CTAs. keep hero language non-technical but credible.
mei (design): visual idea: single-row hero with left = one-line headline + savings callout, center = monthly runway chart (projected spend vs savings at scale), right = small dev toggle that shows p50/p95. mobile stacks.
nana (product): data source: last quarter v2-opt + dedicated quant runs. ravi pls provide placeholder CSV for the runway chart.
ravi (analytics): sample CSV (placeholder) for layout:
```
month,est_tokens,hosted_cost_usd,dedicated_cost_usd
1,50000,10.0,4.0
2,120000,24.0,9.6
3,300000,60.0,24.0
4,600000,120.0,48.0
```
use for axis scales. note: dedicated numbers assume quantized configs and typical batching.
sara (growth): CTA variants to test: A) "Estimate savings" (calculator -> sales route for >$1500/mo) B) "Start free" (trial funnel for engineers). run 2-week AB.
josh (marketing): recommended hero copy (finance): "Forecast your inference spend. Reduce unit cost without hidden trade-offs." dev subhead toggled: "p50s from ~80ms; predictable tail behavior."
mei (design): will mock hero + mobile by Thu. include a small footnote area for qualifiers: quantization, batch assumptions, cache warm/cold.
ravi (analytics): routing: calculator leads with est_monthly_tokens field. if est_monthly_cost_saved > $500 OR est_tokens > 100k -> AE handoff. instrument utm + partner id.
ana (product): for webinar planning, segment invites: Finance (runway + procurement), Platform (autoscaling + KV cache), ML Eng (latency/throughput deep dive). create short abstracts for each.
sara (growth): timeline: copy Wed, design Thu, review Mon, AB live next Wed. owners: josh copy, mei design, ravi metrics, ana webinar segs, sara launch. small sync Mon 10m to sign off.
josh (marketing): I'll avoid absolute "x-fold" claims in hero; use "up to" in callouts with footnote. will draft two social captions and the calculator microcopy by EOD.
mei (design): noted. I'll include a tiny testimonial slot for finance if legal clears a one-line quote.
sara (growth): great work team  we'll iterate on the runway chart after real numbers from ravi. ping here when CSV ready. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
